PORTABLE RECOVERY PACKAGE

Download enough to rebuild the meaning.

The data-and-engine snapshot is deliberately redundant: canonical records for machines, a catalog for simple tools, schemas for validation, recovery prose for humans, and cryptographic manifests for change detection. It is not the presentation layer.

Download BagIt ZIPDeterministic, recursively downloadable data-and-engine snapshot.Inspect BagIt subsetSelf-identifying payload with SHA-256 and SHA-512 manifests.Print coreHuman-readable identity, protocol separations, and every current plain explanation.Current JSONLThe complete current logical seed in one stream.All revisionsLegacy and current exact records, never silently overwritten.SHA-256 manifestWhole-release fixity listing.SHA-512 manifestAdditional SHA-2 fixity listing; algorithm agility remains required.

RECOVERY ORDER

If every interface is gone.

  1. Read
    protocol/CORE.txt
  2. Verify
    manifest hashes
  3. Parse
    archive/current.jsonl
  4. Resolve
    exact revision references
  5. Render
    plain and exact layers
  6. Mirror
    complete files plus witness record

WHAT A HASH CANNOT DO

Fixity is not authenticity, truth, or preservation by itself.

A digest detects whether bytes changed relative to a known manifest. Custodians must still establish who witnessed a release, preserve multiple copies, migrate algorithms and media, and review the mathematical content.

  • Archive encodingUTF-8
  • Line endingsLF
  • Current streamJSONL
  • BagIt version1.0
  • Runtime to readNONE
  • Verify / executePYTHON + NODE
